data.description: During hapuku change 2852, the first manual Gerrit Verified run failed closed without a code failure: ubuntu lanes failed because tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py could not git show c57057f41:.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml, and a later macOS lane failed with 'could not fetch main to verify the module-size limit lock; failing closed.' Retrying the same patchset revision (19de7b21f43596c6b17c60899611111ff7876a60) passed as run 34290258048, so this is CI infrastructure / trusted-main fetch robustness, not hapuku code. Acceptance criteria: reproduce or explain the missing ancestry/fetch path, make the trusted-main/module-size/parity checks deterministic for Gerrit patchset checkouts, and keep fail-closed semantics for real drift.
data.title: Gerrit Verified retry needed after trusted-main fetch and ancestry failures
